image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: mobile hairstyling education case image, a clean 2x2 four-view salon contact sheet with no text
Primary request: create four consistent observational salon photographs of the same fictional adult East Asian woman showing only her current hairstyle; this is not a before-and-after comparison
Scene/backdrop: plain soft warm-gray salon wall, uncluttered, identical background in every panel
Subject: same adult woman in every panel, natural unretouched skin and realistic facial texture, neutral relaxed expression, upright head, simple muted terracotta crew-neck top; complete head, hairline, neck and both shoulders visible
Current hair: dark brown neck-length bob ending between jaw and shoulder, natural center-to-slightly-off-center part, forehead exposed, no bangs; front hairline density looks modest rather than thick, with a realistic slightly wider part near the front but no bald patches and no medical-looking hair loss; medium overall density, fine-to-medium strands, mostly straight crown and sides with a faint irregular bend at the ends; continuous moderately full perimeter, modest ordinary volume, long front pieces
Composition/framing: 2x2 grid with equal panels and thin neutral gutters. Top left true front view. Top right exact right profile. Bottom left exact left profile. Bottom right direct back view. Keep facial identity, head-neck-shoulder proportions, clothing, hair color, part, apparent length, perimeter and lighting consistent. Camera at eye level, pulled back enough to include the entire head, all hair ends, full neck, both complete shoulder outlines and upper torso in each panel.
Lighting/mood: soft even daylight-balanced studio light, honest salon consultation photography, realistic individual hairs and small flyaways, no beauty filter
Constraints: one adult only; current starting condition only; no fringe, no transformation, no reference hairstyle, no exercise scene, no wet/sweaty hair, no tools, no labels, no arrows, no measurements, no watermark, no logos; hair outside shape must not exaggerate or claim skull anatomy; do not diagnose thinning
Avoid: glamour editorial styling, exaggerated volume, perfect mirror symmetry, dramatic curls, face reshaping, skin smoothing, heavy makeup, jewellery, cropped crown, cropped shoulders, text
